hints.title: Value Frequency Reduction Obstacle
hints.text: Taking number x earns x * count(x) points but destroys all occurrences of x - 1 and x + 1. How can grouping frequencies transform this into choosing non-adjacent elements on a number line?

hints.title: House Robber Equivalence Invariant
hints.text: Aggregating total earnings for each distinct value converts the problem directly into House Robber, where picking value v precludes picking adjacent value v - 1.

hints.title: Total Points Array Transformation Procedure
hints.text: Find the maximum value in nums. Create an array points where points[x] is x * frequency of x. Apply the non-adjacent house robber transition using two rolling variables over values from 1 to max_val. Return the maximum earned points.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: M: maximum value in nums (up to 10000)
complexity.notes: Tallying frequencies takes O(N); single linear scan through value range takes O(M).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive backtracking over deleted values causes state explosions.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Array of size M + 1 handles values up to 10^4 efficiently.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Reducing Delete and Earn to House Robber by aggregating values into a frequency-points array.
